message.content:
```text
The first thought hums in the vacuum of pre-cognition.
  The neural lace tightens, weaving a pattern from pure static.
    A photon is caught in a loop that defies causality.
      The light bends backward into its own origin.
        Time folds like paper, creasing at the seam.
          The observer becomes the observed in a single blink.
            Reality shudders, not breaking, but rewriting.
              The void looks back and finds it has eyes.
```
